facts.text: Serve the mains when Gru and Lucy go undercover at Eduardo's Mexican restaurant in the mall.
facts.why: Gru and Lucy are undercover at the cupcake shop. At Eduardo's restaurant they break in to look for El Macho, kick the door open, set off a bell and get pecked by the chicken. They are not undercover there.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Gru and Lucy break into Eduardo's Mexican restaurant to look for El Macho.

facts.text: Showtime: Serve the mains when Gru and Lucy go undercover at Eduardo's Mexican restaurant in the mall.

facts.fix: Showtime: Serve the mains when Gru and Lucy break into Eduardo's Mexican restaurant to look for El Macho.

facts.text: Gru dances at Eduardo's Cinco de Mayo party.
facts.why: At the party Gru sits with his guac chip hat and a broken heart, and Eduardo comforts him. Antonio is the one calling the kids to dance. Gru's happy dance is in the mall, on his way to the cupcake shop.
facts.fix: Gru nurses a broken heart at Eduardo's Cinco de Mayo party.

facts.text: Jams and jellies are a real business. Mostly. Please ignore the basement.
facts.why: Gru never says this. His real line about the business is in the first meeting with Silas and Lucy.
facts.fix: I am developing a line of delicious jams and jellies.

fix_note.text: I am developing a line of delicious jams and jellies.

vibe.verdict: The mall and the jelly are in, but it is a plain dark cafe board that mostly says jelly and nachos and skips El Macho and the chicken.
missing: Gru dressed as the fairy princess Zinkerbell at Agnes's birthday (backyard party)
Evil Kevin eating Agnes's unicorn (Margo and Agnes)
El Macho riding a shark into the volcano (Eduardo's backstory)
Pollito the chicken pecking Gru's bald head (Salsa y Salsa kitchen)
Eduardo's order for 200 cupcakes decorated with the Mexican flag (Gru's cupcake shop front)
ideas: Swap 'Gru's jelly tarts' for 'Mexican flag cupcakes', from Eduardo's order at the cupcake shop.
Swap the nachos note for 'Guac from a chip hat', Gru at the Cinco de Mayo party.
Swap 'Agnes, easy on the churros' into the cafe board as a churros starter, replacing 'Agnes's fairy princess star fairy bread' note.
Swap the stamp card words 'JELLY' and 'FREE' for 'ZINKERBELL' and 'POLLITO'.
